items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Now that's my grandson, George McCollum.

ctx.x: People told us about Professor Annette. Professor Annette. Oh, Amanda? Have you seen Amanda? Oh, you have a lot of. I'm sure he came by my place this afternoon. I'd like to see. He stops by when he goes to church for an open. We like to see. Oh, he and George, they play music.

I thought we had to play so much together. And he'd follow George home and I'd get mad and put them all out. Those were some days. That's the band that was not in the building. Oh, yeah. Now that's my grandson, George McCollum.
He didn't keep up your mute. He's a job. He's a piece of the paper.
